name: scapula dips
description: A scapular dip, moving the shoulder blades while your arms stay straight. Strengthens the traps and shoulder stabilisers.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your hands flat on it beside your hips and your arms straight.
Keep your elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Press your shoulders down, away from your ears, so your hips lift slightly off the bench.
Let your shoulders rise back toward your ears to lower your hips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
